metadata: 
  node_type: memory
  type: project
  originSessionId: 8f7949d7-58d7-4c8a-83f1-6e0cb5db1986
---

本机 SDC 激发战役 2026-10-16 01:27 上线（goal: 捕获自然类型 SDC 完整信息）。布局：

- **战役引擎**: `~/sdc-excite-reproduce/`（`scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/sdc-excite-reproduce.sh full`，用户态 nohup 运行，非 systemd——无 root）。cycle 循环 L1冷启→L2谱系→L3轮转6h→L5→L4驻留至次日07:30。
- **基线**: `~/sdc-run/scan-baseline-1015-2359/` 126核×13行全 pass（零 fail/skip）。
- **三伴层**（`~/sdc-run/`，均为运维脚本不入库）: `user_monitor.sh`（温度看门狗 ≥90C 写 PAUSE / ≤85C 撤，写 monitor.csv 供 heatsoak 温度带判断，温度必须写°C 不能写 mC）；`mem_saturate.sh`（stress-ng --vm 2G×N 自适应，目标带 MemAvailable [6.5,8]GiB——护住战役 6GB 复测护栏；swap 守卫只看 pswpout 换出，换入是良性回读）；`cpu_backfill.sh` v2（增量+滞回 idle 8%±5%，stress-ng --cpu-method **matrixprod**（0.18 无 matrix 名）--verify=第二 SDC 检出器；v1 全量重算会 bang-bang 振荡）。
- **巡检**: durable cron `13,43 * * * *`（7 天自动过期，需续期），日志 `~/sdc-run/patrol.log`。
- **平台事实**（实测 2026-10-16，与 CLAUDE.md "SVE VL=256" 记载不同——那指另一台主机）: 本机 TaiShan 2280 Kunpeng 920 **无 SVE**（sve* 用例全 skip 是预期）；126/128 在线（**122,123 离线**，原因未查明）；无 root（电压/调频/核上线杠杆不可用）；cpufreq 锁 performance 2.6GHz；thermal=acpitz×2；HOME=/home/sdc（不是 /home/sdc/wangxu）。
- **已知噪声**: L1 lock/atomic 段 32 线程设计性低占用；-t 裸数字=毫秒（20=20ms，会退化成最小1迭代长跑）；par=32 全核扫描时 32×eigen_svd(mdim 2048,2.2GiB/实例) 内存超订 2.4×→swap-in 良性；eigen_svd mdim=4096 单线程>333s 触发框架 hang 判定；`pkill -f` 模式会匹配自身命令行自杀（用分离命令或 pgrep 最小化调用）。
- **sdc-run.sh**（已入仓库 feat/sdc-run-scan 分支）: `scan` 子命令逐核定位，YAML 同名测试多数据集条目须"任一 fail 即 fail"。

**2026-10-16 最终判定（当日两度修正，实证优先）**：原报"CPU27 SDC 候选"经簇锚定对照实验**改判为 mesh_upi_avx512_symm_int 测试竞态伪影**（目标簇+健康对照簇均 8/8 假 FAIL，expected_sum=0+跨迭代混合读）。**本机无确认自然 SDC**；全部异常已定性：mesh 族=测试竞态（**已全族根除**：v2 范式 13b13850 + 10 文件迁移 1724c4d3，19/19 文件均为感知反转协议，验证含双簇 600s 饱和驻留）、sm3sm4=大 data_size(≥16M 病理)软件缺陷（根因待查）、mesh_upi_sse_sym crash=OOM 伪影、eigen=已知限制。方法论教训入档 `docs/cases/sdc-2026-10-16-core27-mesh-upi/`：**单事件定性必须先做对照簇复现，协议推演只能排序假设不能定案**。框架模型实证：每测试按调度量子重跑（120s≈101 条目，每条目独立 test_init/td）。`-t` 裸数字=毫秒（dwell 脚本已修，sdc-run.sh 文档已警示）。分支 feat/sdc-run-scan 12 提交（scan 工具/透传/README/案例/v2/族迁移/dwell 修复等）。

**Why:** 巡检 cron 与未来会话解读战役数据时必需的运维上下文；平台事实纠正常见误判（如把 sve skip 当异常）。
**How to apply:** 巡检/分析战役结果时先读 `~/sdc-run/patrol.log` 与本记忆的已知噪声表；mesh 族 fail 一律先查竞态伪影；事件判读对照 [[cn23154-numa3-va-path-fault]] 的位签名。

11	
12	为复现该故障,仓库 feat/sve512-gather-scatter-arm 分支新增 8 个 sve512 测试(#271-278:arm 家族 4 + SVD-format 家族 4,注册于 tests_arm64_sve 库)。已知待修 bug(集成前已警告用户,代码按用户指示原样集成):sve512_gather_scatter_svd(#278)init 尾块置换越界(300 非 16 倍数,row/col 最大 303,gather_idx[91203] 越 90000 元素 vector 约 1.2k 元素,任何 SVE 机器必崩,-n 1 也崩);gather_scatter 系(arm+svd)多线程共享 scatter_dst/golden + 每线程 std::fill(0) 竞态(满核假 FAIL)。chain/special 六个测试(#272-277)边界已核算、无私有竞态、golden 逐 op 确定,为干净代码。
13	
14	2026-09-15 用户报告:8 测试在 cn23154 上把 sdcshield 跑崩(单核即崩)。单核崩溃与线程数无关 → 锁定 #278 OOB(集成前两次预警的 bug)。当日已修复:PR #109 将 a3cadbd6 + bb41f231 合入远端 main(13bda7ef)。#278 尾块 clamp + golden 预计算 + dst 线程局部 + whilelt;#275-277 块主序布局(分配 5.5GiB→22.6MB)。主机侧整数模拟实证零越界。
15	
16	cn23154 目标机(/home/share/suke/sdcshield,构建 builddir-xupeng,BiSheng clang 19.1.7 + 一键脚本)的树是手工改造版:SVE 库自命名 tests_arm64_sve512(仓库版叫 tests_arm64_sve),另有仓库不存在的 sme_fmopa_arm.cpp(他人本地新增)——不能整文件覆盖其 meson.build。2026-09-15 晚构建失败两因:① gather_scatter_svd.cpp 粘贴时文件头损坏(第 2 行成 "pyright" 残片,/** 丢失);② 该文件被误注册进基线库 arm64_tests(无 +sve)。干净分发包:/tmp/sve512-fix-20260915.tar.gz(git archive 分支顶端,9 文件+SHA256SUMS)。BiSheng clang 下其余 272 目标全部编过,工具链兼容。已知软件 bug 清零后若目标机再崩,崩点即硬件新证据(按 VA[55:48] 位签名判读)。
17	
18	**Why:** 跨会话的故障复现工程;两份诊断报告内容不在仓库里,而位级判别判据(si_addr 低 48 位完好性、簇锚定、健康簇对照、~19min 节律)是解读后续复现结果的必需上下文。
19	**How to apply:** 处理 sve512 测试或 cn23154 复现结果时,先对照本记忆的故障签名;#278 的崩溃在 OOB 修复前不构成硬件证据;#272-277 若崩且带高位签名 + NUMA3 锚定,才是几周复现努力要找的信号。

content.content:
1	#!/bin/bash
2	# ============================================================
3	# sdc-run.sh — SDC 压测统一入口（scan：逐核定位分析）
4	#
5	# 子命令:
6	#   scan   逐核定位：对 --cores 的每个核单独运行 SDC 敏感用例集
7	#          （--cpuset=<core> 单核绑定，邻居静默），产出 core×test
8	#          结果矩阵与异常报告；失败对自动确认复测区分 瞬态/持续。
9	#
10	# 用法:
11	#   bash scripts/run/sdc-run.sh scan [选项]
12	#     --bin PATH    sdcshield 二进制（缺省: $SDC_BIN → ./builddir/sdcshield
13	#                   → ./builddir-gcc/sdcshield，找不到 fail-loud 退出）
14	#     --cores SPEC  核列表: all（缺省=全部在线核）| 0-31 | 0,4,8 | 0-31,64
15	#     --tests LIST  逗号分隔用例名（缺省 DEFAULT_TESTS；全部须存在于
16	#                   --list-tests，缺失 fail-loud 列名退出）
17	#     --t DUR       每用例每核时长，透传 -t（缺省 5s；裸数字=毫秒，
18	#                   框架语义——建议带 s 后缀）
19	#     --par N       并行实例数（缺省 1；实例按簇交错调度避免同簇双载，
20	#                   仅加速，每核归因不变——同核绝不双实例）
21	#     --quality N   质量档（缺省 0=PROD+BETA，arm64_sdc 等 BETA 用例需要）
22	#     --retest N    框架级失败重测（缺省 3，透传 --retest-on-failure）
23	#     --out DIR     输出根目录（缺省 ./sdc-run-scan-<MMDD-HHMMSS>/）

53	BIN_OVERRIDE=""; CORES_SPEC="all"; TESTS="$DEFAULT_TESTS"

55	while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
56	    case "$1" in
57	        --bin)     BIN_OVERRIDE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
58	        --cores)   CORES_SPEC="$2"; shift 2 ;;
59	        --tests)   TESTS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
60	        --t)       T_PER="$2"; shift 2 ;;

71	[ "$RETEST" -ge 0 ] 2>/dev/null || { echo "FATAL: --retest 须为 >=0 整数" >&2; exit 2; }

73	# ---------------- 二进制发现（fail-loud，与 sdc_detect.sh 同约定） ----------------
74	if [ -n "$BIN_OVERRIDE" ]; then BIN="$BIN_OVERRIDE"
75	else
76	    BIN="${SDC_BIN:-}"
77	    for c in ./builddir/sdcshield ./builddir-gcc/sdcshield; do

82	    echo "FATAL: 未找到可执行的 sdcshield（--bin/SDC_BIN/./builddir/./builddir-gcc 均未命中）" >&2

101	spec = sys.argv[1].strip()

128	# ---------------- 簇交错重排（--par>1 时各实例分散到不同簇） ----------------

137	ORDERED=$(while read -r c; do echo "$(cluster_of "$c") $c"; done <<< "$CORES" | python3 -c "
138	import sys
139	from collections import defaultdict
140	# 输入: 每行 '<簇代表核> <核>'；输出: 簇交错序（第 r 轮取每簇第 r 个核
141	# → 前 N_簇 个启动实例互不同簇；PAR ≤ 簇数时同簇绝不并行）
142	g = defaultdict(list)
143	for l in sys.stdin:

174	cleanup() {  # Ctrl-C: 杀子进程，已完成核照常出矩阵（不丢已采数据）

176	    for p in "${PIDS[@]:-}"; do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done

198	    #   任一条目 fail → fail；全条目 skip → skip；否则 pass。

202	outdir, tests = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2].split(",")

205	    m = re.search(r"core_(\d+)\.yaml$", f)

209	for c in cores:
210	    cur = None
211	    for line in open("%s/core_%d.yaml" % (outdir, c), errors="replace"):
212	        m = re.match(r"^- test: (\S+)", line)
213	        if m: cur = m.group(1); entries.setdefault(cur, {}).setdefault(c, [])
214	        m = re.match(r"^  result: (\S+)", line)
215	        if m and cur: entries[cur][c].append(m.group(1).rstrip(","))
216	def verdict(vals):
217	    if not vals: return "-"
218	    if "fail" in vals: return "fail"
219	    if all(v == "skip" for v in vals): return "skip"
220	    return "pass"
221	print("test\t" + "\t".join(map(str, cores)))
222	for t in tests + (["mce_check"] if "mce_check" in entries else []):
223	    row = [verdict(entries.get(t, {}).get(c)) for c in cores]
224	    print(t + "\t" + "\t".join(row))
225	PY
226	}
227	build_matrix
228	
229	# ---------------- 确认复测（失败对 ×1，静默邻居单跑） ----------------
230	FAIL_PAIRS=$(python3 - "$OUT" "$TESTS" <<'PY'
231	import sys
232	outdir, tests = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2].split(",")
233	header = None
234	for line in open(outdir + "/matrix.tsv"):
235	    if line.startswith("test\t"):
236	        header = [int(x) for x in line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")[1:]]
237	        continue
238	    parts = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
239	    t, cells = parts[0], parts[1:]
240	    if t not in tests: continue
241	    for c, r in zip(header, cells):
242	        if r == "fail":
243	            print("%s %s" % (c, t))
244	PY
245	)
246	CONFIRM_MD=""
247	RC=0
248	if [ -n "$FAIL_PAIRS" ]; then
249	    log "确认复测 $(echo "$FAIL_PAIRS" | wc -l) 个失败对（单跑 ×1）"
250	    while read -r core test; do
251	        [ -z "$test" ] && continue
252	        "$BIN" --cpuset="$core" -t "$T_PER" -Y --quality="$QUALITY" \
253	            ${PASSTHRU[@]+"${PASSTHRU[@]}"} \
254	            -e "$test" -o "$OUT/confirm_${core}_${test}.yaml" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
255	        CR=$(grep -m1 "^  result:" "$OUT/confirm_${core}_${test}.yaml" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}' || true)
256	        if [ "$CR" = "fail" ]; then CLASS="持续(复现)"; else CLASS="瞬态(未复现)"; fi
257	        CONFIRM_MD="$CONFIRM_MD
258	| $core | $test | ${CR:-无结果} | $CLASS |"
259	        log "确认核 $core $test → ${CR:-无结果}（$CLASS）"
260	    done <<< "$FAIL_PAIRS"
261	    RC=1
262	fi
263	
264	# ---------------- report.md ----------------
265	generate_report() {
266	    python3 - "$OUT" > "$OUT/report.md" <<'PY'
267	import sys, datetime
268	outdir = sys.argv[1]
269	m = open(outdir + "/matrix.tsv").read().splitlines()
270	header = m[0].split("\t")[1:]
271	print("# SDC 逐核定位扫描报告\n")
272	print("- 生成: %s" % datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"))
273	print("- 核数: %d；矩阵见 matrix.tsv\n" % len(header))
274	stats = {}
275	for line in m[1:]:
276	    for r in line.split("\t")[1:]:
277	        stats[r] = stats.get(r, 0) + 1
278	print("## 结果统计\n")
279	for k in sorted(stats): print("- %s: %d" % (k, stats[k]))
280	PY
281	    if [ -n "${CONFIRM_MD:-}" ]; then
282	        printf '\n## 确认复测（失败对单跑复测）\n\n| 核 | 用例 | 复测结果 | 分类 |\n|---|---|---|---|\n%s\n' \
283	            "$CONFIRM_MD" >> "$OUT/report.md"
284	    fi
285	}
286	generate_report
287	log "scan 完成: 矩阵=$OUT/matrix.tsv 报告=$OUT/report.md 退出码=$RC"
288	exit $RC

#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================
# sdc-run.sh — SDC 压测统一入口（scan：逐核定位分析）
#
# 子命令:
#   scan   逐核定位：对 --cores 的每个核单独运行 SDC 敏感用例集
#          （--cpuset=<core> 单核绑定，邻居静默），产出 core×test
#          结果矩阵与异常报告；失败对自动确认复测区分 瞬态/持续。
#
# 用法:
#   bash scripts/run/sdc-run.sh scan [选项]
#     --bin PATH    sdcshield 二进制（缺省: $SDC_BIN → ./builddir/sdcshield
#                   → ./builddir-gcc/sdcshield，找不到 fail-loud 退出）
#     --cores SPEC  核列表: all（缺省=全部在线核）| 0-31 | 0,4,8 | 0-31,64
#     --tests LIST  逗号分隔用例名（缺省 DEFAULT_TESTS；全部须存在于
#                   --list-tests，缺失 fail-loud 列名退出）
#     --t DUR       每用例每核时长，透传 -t（缺省 5s；裸数字=毫秒，
#                   框架语义——建议带 s 后缀）
#     --par N       并行实例数（缺省 1；实例按簇交错调度避免同簇双载，
#                   仅加速，每核归因不变——同核绝不双实例）
#     --quality N   质量档（缺省 0=PROD+BETA，arm64_sdc 等 BETA 用例需要）
#     --retest N    框架级失败重测（缺省 3，透传 --retest-on-failure）
#     --out DIR     输出根目录（缺省 ./sdc-run-scan-<MMDD-HHMMSS>/）
#     -- <框架参数> 双划线后的一切原样透传给 sdcshield（如 -s AES 换 RNG 引擎、
#                  -O eigen_svd_double.mdim=3072 调用例参数、--test-list-randomize
#                  随机序）。不得传 -e/--cpuset/-o/-t/-Y/--quality 等破坏编排的
#                  选项——那会污染逐核归因。
#
# 产出:
#   <out>/core_<N>.yaml            每核完整 YAML（-Y）
#   <out>/matrix.tsv               core × test 矩阵（pass/fail/skip）
#   <out>/report.md                摘要+异常+确认复测分类
#   <out>/scan.log                 进度日志（每核一行）
#
# 退出码: 0=无 fail；1=存在 fail（含确认分类）；2=用法/环境错误
# 设计依据: docs/superpowers/plans/2026-10-15-sdc-run-scan-excitation.md
# ============================================================
set -euo pipefail
usage() { sed -n '3,33p' "$0" | sed 's/^# \{0,1\}//'; }

# 本机敏感集（Kunpeng 920 无 SVE——sve* 用例不在集内；名字已对
# --quality=0 --list-tests 核实。P1 向量FMA/矩阵 + P2 ARM64 SDC 专项 + P4 位扩散）
DEFAULT_TESTS="eigen_gemm_double_dynamic_square,eigen_svd_double,openblas_dgemm,sleef_neon,fma,power_virus_dit,arm64_sdc,ooo_dep_chain_arm,lsu_store_forward_arm,neon_add,zstd19,openssl_sha"

[ $# -ge 1 ] || { usage; exit 2; }
CMD="$1"; shift
case "$CMD" in
    scan) ;;
    -h|--help|help) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "FATAL: 未知子命令 '$CMD'（可用: scan）" >&2; exit 2 ;;
esac

BIN_OVERRIDE=""; CORES_SPEC="all"; TESTS="$DEFAULT_TESTS"
T_PER="5s"; PAR=1; QUALITY=0; RETEST=3; OUT=""; PASSTHRU=()
while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
    case "$1" in
        --bin)     BIN_OVERRIDE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --cores)   CORES_SPEC="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --tests)   TESTS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --t)       T_PER="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --par)     PAR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --quality) QUALITY="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --retest)  RETEST="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --out)     OUT="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --)        shift; PASSTHRU=("$@"); break ;;
        -h|--help) usage; exit 0 ;;
        *) echo "FATAL: scan 未知选项 '$1'（框架参数请放在 -- 之后）" >&2; exit 2 ;;
    esac
done
[ "$PAR" -ge 1 ] 2>/dev/null || { echo "FATAL: --par 须为 >=1 整数" >&2; exit 2; }
[ "$RETEST" -ge 0 ] 2>/dev/null || { echo "FATAL: --retest 须为 >=0 整数" >&2; exit 2; }

# ---------------- 二进制发现（fail-loud，与 sdc_detect.sh 同约定） ----------------
if [ -n "$BIN_OVERRIDE" ]; then BIN="$BIN_OVERRIDE"
else
    BIN="${SDC_BIN:-}"
    for c in ./builddir/sdcshield ./builddir-gcc/sdcshield; do
        [ -x "$c" ] && BIN="$c" && break
    done
fi
[ -n "$BIN" ] && [ -x "$BIN" ] || {
    echo "FATAL: 未找到可执行的 sdcshield（--bin/SDC_BIN/./builddir/./builddir-gcc 均未命中）" >&2
    exit 2; }

# ---------------- 用例名存在性校验（fail-loud） ----------------
TMP_LIST=$(mktemp); trap 'rm -f "$TMP_LIST"' EXIT
"$BIN" --quality="$QUALITY" --list-tests > "$TMP_LIST" 2>/dev/null \
    || { echo "FATAL: --list-tests 执行失败" >&2; exit 2; }
MISSING=""
while IFS= read -r t; do
    [ -n "$t" ] || continue
    grep -qx "$t" "$TMP_LIST" || MISSING="$MISSING $t"
done < <(printf '%s\n' "$TESTS" | tr ',' '\n')
[ -z "$MISSING" ] || { echo "FATAL: 以下用例不在 --list-tests（--quality=$QUALITY）:$MISSING" >&2; exit 2; }
N_TESTS=$(printf '%s\n' "$TESTS" | tr ',' '\n' | grep -c .)

# ---------------- 核列表展开（all=仅在线核，离线核报错） ----------------
expand_spec() {  # "0-3,7" → 每行一核
    python3 - "$1" <<'PY'
import sys
spec = sys.argv[1].strip()
if spec == "all":
    spec = open("/sys/devices/system/cpu/online").read().strip()
out = []
for part in spec.split(","):
    part = part.strip()
    if not part: continue
    if "-" in part:
        a, b = part.split("-"); out += list(range(int(a), int(b) + 1))
    else:
        out.append(int(part))
online = set()
for part in open("/sys/devices/system/cpu/online").read().strip().split(","):
    if "-" in part:
        a, b = part.split("-"); online.update(range(int(a), int(b) + 1))
    else: online.add(int(part))
bad = [c for c in out if c not in online]
if bad:
    sys.stderr.write("FATAL: 核 %s 不在线\n" % ",".join(map(str, sorted(set(bad))))); sys.exit(1)
seen = set()
for c in out:
    if c not in seen: seen.add(c); print(c)
PY
}
CORES=$(expand_spec "$CORES_SPEC") || exit 2
N_CORES=$(echo "$CORES" | wc -l)

# ---------------- 簇交错重排（--par>1 时各实例分散到不同簇） ----------------
cluster_of() {  # 核→簇代表核（cluster_cpus_list 首核；缺失回退 die，再回退 4 核均匀切）
    local c="$1" cl
    for f in cluster_cpus_list die_cpus_list; do
        cl=$(cat "/sys/devices/system/cpu/cpu$c/$f" 2>/dev/null) || continue
        echo "${cl%%[-,]*}"; return
    done
    echo $(( (10#$c / 4) * 4 ))
}
ORDERED=$(while read -r c; do echo "$(cluster_of "$c") $c"; done <<< "$CORES" | python3 -c "
import sys
from collections import defaultdict
# 输入: 每行 '<簇代表核> <核>'；输出: 簇交错序（第 r 轮取每簇第 r 个核
# → 前 N_簇 个启动实例互不同簇；PAR ≤ 簇数时同簇绝不并行）
g = defaultdict(list)
for l in sys.stdin:
    p = l.split()
    if len(p) == 2: g[int(p[0])].append(int(p[1]))
rows = [sorted(v) for _, v in sorted(g.items())]
out = []
if rows:
    for r in range(max(len(x) for x in rows)):
        for row in rows:
            if len(row) > r: out.append(row[r])
print('\n'.join(map(str, out)))
")

# ---------------- 输出目录 ----------------
[ -n "$OUT" ] || OUT="./sdc-run-scan-$(date +%m%d-%H%M%S)"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
LOG="$OUT/scan.log"
log() { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%F %T')" "$*" | tee -a "$LOG"; }
log "scan 开始: cores=$N_CORES tests=$N_TESTS t=$T_PER par=$PAR quality=$QUALITY bin=$BIN out=$OUT"
log "测试集: $TESTS"

# ---------------- 单核执行 ----------------
run_one() {
    local core="$1"
    "$BIN" --cpuset="$core" -t "$T_PER" -Y \
        --quality="$QUALITY" --retest-on-failure="$RETEST" \
        --on-crash=context --on-hang=kill --ignore-timeout --ignore-os-errors \
        ${PASSTHRU[@]+"${PASSTHRU[@]}"} \
        -e "$TESTS" -o "$OUT/core_${core}.yaml" \
        > "$OUT/core_${core}.stdout" 2>&1
}
PIDS=()
cleanup() {  # Ctrl-C: 杀子进程，已完成核照常出矩阵（不丢已采数据）
    trap - INT TERM
    for p in "${PIDS[@]:-}"; do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done
    wait 2>/dev/null || true
    build_matrix || true
    generate_report || true
    log "被中断：部分矩阵已落盘 $OUT/matrix.tsv"
    exit 130
}
trap cleanup INT TERM

# ---------------- 并行调度（已用核集合防重叠；单核失败不中断全局） ----------------
DONE=0
for core in $ORDERED; do
    while [ "$(jobs -rp | wc -l)" -ge "$PAR" ]; do wait -n || true; done
    run_one "$core" & PIDS+=($!)
    DONE=$((DONE + 1))
    log "核 $core 启动（$DONE/$N_CORES）"
done
wait || true

# ---------------- 矩阵 ----------------
build_matrix() {
    # 解析规则（实测 YAML 结构——同名测试多数据集条目，如 fma×33）：
    #   任一条目 fail → fail；全条目 skip → skip；否则 pass。
    # mce_check（框架自动追加的 EDAC 检查）作为信息行附在矩阵末尾。
    python3 - "$OUT" "$TESTS" > "$OUT/matrix.tsv" <<'PY'
import sys, glob, re
outdir, tests = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2].split(",")
cores = []
for f in glob.glob(outdir + "/core_*.yaml"):
    m = re.search(r"core_(\d+)\.yaml$", f)
    if m: cores.append(int(m.group(1)))
cores.sort()
entries = {}  # entries[test][core] = [result, ...]
for c in cores:
    cur = None
    for line in open("%s/core_%d.yaml" % (outdir, c), errors="replace"):
        m = re.match(r"^- test: (\S+)", line)
        if m: cur = m.group(1); entries.setdefault(cur, {}).setdefault(c, [])
        m = re.match(r"^  result: (\S+)", line)
        if m and cur: entries[cur][c].append(m.group(1).rstrip(","))
def verdict(vals):
    if not vals: return "-"
    if "fail" in vals: return "fail"
    if all(v == "skip" for v in vals): return "skip"
    return "pass"
print("test\t" + "\t".join(map(str, cores)))
for t in tests + (["mce_check"] if "mce_check" in entries else []):
    row = [verdict(entries.get(t, {}).get(c)) for c in cores]
    print(t + "\t" + "\t".join(row))
PY
}
build_matrix

# ---------------- 确认复测（失败对 ×1，静默邻居单跑） ----------------
FAIL_PAIRS=$(python3 - "$OUT" "$TESTS" <<'PY'
import sys
outdir, tests = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2].split(",")
header = None
for line in open(outdir + "/matrix.tsv"):
    if line.startswith("test\t"):
        header = [int(x) for x in line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")[1:]]
        continue
    parts = line.rstrip("\n").split("\t")
    t, cells = parts[0], parts[1:]
    if t not in tests: continue
    for c, r in zip(header, cells):
        if r == "fail":
            print("%s %s" % (c, t))
PY
)
CONFIRM_MD=""
RC=0
if [ -n "$FAIL_PAIRS" ]; then
    log "确认复测 $(echo "$FAIL_PAIRS" | wc -l) 个失败对（单跑 ×1）"
    while read -r core test; do
        [ -z "$test" ] && continue
        "$BIN" --cpuset="$core" -t "$T_PER" -Y --quality="$QUALITY" \
            ${PASSTHRU[@]+"${PASSTHRU[@]}"} \
            -e "$test" -o "$OUT/confirm_${core}_${test}.yaml" > /dev/null 2>&1 || true
        CR=$(grep -m1 "^  result:" "$OUT/confirm_${core}_${test}.yaml" 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}' || true)
        if [ "$CR" = "fail" ]; then CLASS="持续(复现)"; else CLASS="瞬态(未复现)"; fi
        CONFIRM_MD="$CONFIRM_MD
| $core | $test | ${CR:-无结果} | $CLASS |"
        log "确认核 $core $test → ${CR:-无结果}（$CLASS）"
    done <<< "$FAIL_PAIRS"
    RC=1
fi

# ---------------- report.md ----------------
generate_report() {
    python3 - "$OUT" > "$OUT/report.md" <<'PY'
import sys, datetime
outdir = sys.argv[1]
m = open(outdir + "/matrix.tsv").read().splitlines()
header = m[0].split("\t")[1:]
print("# SDC 逐核定位扫描报告\n")
print("- 生成: %s" % datetime.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"))
print("- 核数: %d；矩阵见 matrix.tsv\n" % len(header))
stats = {}
for line in m[1:]:
    for r in line.split("\t")[1:]:
        stats[r] = stats.get(r, 0) + 1
print("## 结果统计\n")
for k in sorted(stats): print("- %s: %d" % (k, stats[k]))
PY
    if [ -n "${CONFIRM_MD:-}" ]; then
        printf '\n## 确认复测（失败对单跑复测）\n\n| 核 | 用例 | 复测结果 | 分类 |\n|---|---|---|---|\n%s\n' \
            "$CONFIRM_MD" >> "$OUT/report.md"
    fi
}
generate_report
log "scan 完成: 矩阵=$OUT/matrix.tsv 报告=$OUT/report.md 退出码=$RC"
exit $RC

- **eigen_svd_double**: 8B × 6 矩阵 × 12 RSS × 650‰ → N = sqrt(29G×0.65/(8×6×12×126)) = sqrt(18.85G/72576) = sqrt(261k) ≈ 511。默认自适应给 ~511？记忆里之前 L3 禁用它是因为旧版硬编码 256×126 线程爆？不对，历史硬编码 256。自适应是后来加的。256 硬编码时代：8×6×12×256²×126 = 6.4G——不会爆啊。嗯，也许 BDCSVD 实际 RSS 远超 12x？记忆说 scan 单核实例 2.2GiB @ mdim=2048：8×6×12×2048² = 2.4GiB ✓ 单线程吻合（12×N²×8×6 = 12 RSS × 6 矩阵 × 8B × N² = 2048²×8×72 = 2.42GiB）。满核 126 线程 × mdim=2048 → 305GiB 灾难。mdim=512 → 19GiB。mdim=576 → 24GiB。mdim=640 → 30GiB 超界。

#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================
# mem_saturate.sh — 内存饱和伴层（用户要求: CPU 与内存都满载）
#
# 自适应目标带:
#   MemAvailable > 8 GiB        → 增一个 2GiB stress-ng --vm-keep 实例
#                                （常驻触碰/重脏页，非仅分配）
#   MemAvailable < 6.5 GiB      → 缩一个实例（护住战役复测护栏 6GB 门
#                                ——复测被 memguard 拦截 = 丢 SDC 证据）
#   swap 换入换出持续非零(si/so) → 缩一个实例（swap thrash 伤确定性）
#
# 物理占用口径: stress-ng 匿名页 + 内核 page cache 自然回填 →
# 目标带内物理占用 ≈ 77-80% anon + cache 打满剩余。
# 退出: kill 主循环（trap 收全部子实例）
# ============================================================
LOGF="$HOME/sdc-run/mem_saturate.log"
PIDS=()
STEP_GB=2
GROW_AVAIL_KB=$((8*1024*1024))     # 8 GiB
SHRINK_AVAIL_KB=$((13*512*1024))   # 6.5 GiB = 6815744 kB
log() { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%F %T')" "$*" >> "$LOGF"; }

cleanup() {
    [ ${#PIDS[@]} -gt 0 ] && kill "${PIDS[@]}" 2>/dev/null
    log "退出: 收 ${#PIDS[@]} 个内存实例"
    exit 0
}
trap cleanup INT TERM EXIT

log "mem_saturate 启动 (pid $$) 步长=${STEP_GB}GiB 目标带=[6.5,8]GiB avail"
while :; do
    ma=$(awk '/^MemAvailable/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo)
    # swap 守卫: 只看持续换出(so)——换入(si)是良性回读(2026-10-16 实测: 基线扫描
    # 超订残留页 si=172/s 持续非零, 旧守卫 si+so>0 恒触发收缩 → 伴层永不增长)
    so1=$(awk '/^pswpout/{print $2}' /proc/vmstat)
    sleep 5
    so2=$(awk '/^pswpout/{print $2}' /proc/vmstat)
    swap_out=$(( so2 - so1 ))

    if [ "$ma" -lt $((3*1024*1024)) ] && [ ${#PIDS[@]} -gt 1 ]; then
        # 危急档(avail<3GiB): 一次杀半数——2026-10-16 实测热扫描 eigen 波次叠加
        # 时 avail 瞬时到 0, 1实例/60s 常规收缩来不及, OOM 会误杀 sdcshield 制造伪事件
        half=$(( ${#PIDS[@]} / 2 ))
        kill "${PIDS[@]:0:$half}" 2>/dev/null
        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]:$half}")
        log "危急收缩: 杀 $half → ${#PIDS[@]} 个 (avail=${ma}kB)"
    elif [ "$swap_out" -gt 200 ] || [ "$ma" -lt "$SHRINK_AVAIL_KB" ]; then
        if [ ${#PIDS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            kill "${PIDS[${#PIDS[@]}-1]}" 2>/dev/null
            unset "PIDS[${#PIDS[@]}-1]"
            log "缩 1 实例 → ${#PIDS[@]} 个 (avail=${ma}kB swap_out=${swap_out}/5s)"
        fi
    elif [ "$ma" -gt "$GROW_AVAIL_KB" ]; then
        stress-ng --vm 1 --vm-bytes "${STEP_GB}g" --vm-keep --vm-method all \
            --metrics-brief >> "$LOGF" 2>&1 &
        PIDS+=($!)
        log "增 1 实例 → ${#PIDS[@]} 个 (avail=${ma}kB)"
    fi
    sleep 55
done

check_pause() { # 驱动侧：联锁暂停等待（PAUSE 内容为原因文本）
    while [ -f "$PAUSE_FLAG" ]; do
        echo "[$(date '+%F %T')] PAUSED: $(cat "$PAUSE_FLAG" 2>/dev/null)"
        sleep 30
    done
}

mem_avail_kb() { awk '/MemAvailable/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo; }

max_mdim_for_threads() { # $1=线程数 → 全核 GEMM mdim 上限
    # scratch ≈ 3*N^2*8B*threads（dgemm 双精度三矩阵），预算 ≤ MemAvailable/2
    python3 -c "
import sys, math
avail = int(open('/proc/meminfo').read().split('MemAvailable:')[1].split()[0]) * 1024
t = int(sys.argv[1]); n = int(math.sqrt(avail * 0.5 / (3 * 8 * t)))
p = 16
while p * 2 <= n: p *= 2
print(min(p, 4096))" "$1"
}

# ---------------- 事件提取（handle_failure 定向复测依据）----------------
# 输入: sdcshield stdout_summary（框架退出时打印的精简失败报告，含 - test: / result: / fail: 块）
# 注意 result 必须同时认 fail 与 crash——RCA 附3 根因：旧实现只匹配 'result: *fail'，
# 2026-09-25 cold_c4 事件（result: crash）提取为空 → 落入 wholecmd 重放（900s×3 重放泄漏命令）
# 而非 120s 定向复测；crash 事件的 fail: 块同样带 AES 种子，故两函数口径一致。
extract_failed_test() {  # $1=stdout_summary 路径 → 首个 fail/crash 事件的测试名（无则空）
    awk '/^- test:/{t=$3} /^  result: *(fail|crash)/{print t; exit}' "$1" 2>/dev/null
}
extract_fail_seed() {    # $1=stdout_summary 路径 → 首个 fail 块内的 AES 种子（无则空）
    grep -m1 '^  fail: {' "$1" 2>/dev/null | grep -oE "AES:[0-9a-f]+"
}

# ---------------- 复现队列产出 + verify.request 消费（M3 T5 驱动集成）----------------
# M2 controller 的 enqueue_reproduction 动作（账本行）在驱动侧的落点：handle_failure
# 台账行后入队 spool/repro_queue/，由 tools/excite/sdc_reproducer.py --from-queue
# 消费（from_event→真实性门禁→capsule+概率复测×3→spool/repro_done，闭环 M3）。
enqueue_repro() {  # enqueue_repro <event_dir> [test] [seed] → spool/repro_queue/<epoch-ns>.json
    local evdir="$1" t="${2:-?}" s="${3:-none}" q
    mkdir -p "$EXCITE_REPRODUCE_DIR/spool/repro_queue"
    q="$EXCITE_REPRODUCE_DIR/spool/repro_queue/$(date +%s%N).json"
    printf '{"event_dir": "%s", "test": "%s", "seed": "%s", "label": "%s", "queued_at": "%s"}\n' \
        "$evdir" "$t" "$s" "$(basename "$evdir")" "$(date -Is)" > "$q.tmp" \
        && mv "$q.tmp" "$q"   # tmp+mv 原子落位（controller 同纪律）：消费者不读半截
}

# cmd/verify.request 消费（M2 T5 移交③闭环）：monitor v3 联锁 PAUSE 时 controller
# 写的只读校验请求（interlock→BLACK）。最小消费者：记台账一行 + touch
# snapshot.request（root monitor 现有 60s 代理吃）+ 按 monitor 命令代理惯例终态化
# verify.done.<epoch>（mv 保留原件内容供审计）。幂等：无请求即 no-op。
=== L3 段如何用 mdim ===
l5_numa() {
    local s
    for s in 0 1 2; do
        export SANDSTONE_STRATEGY_INDEX=$s
        run_sdc "l5_numa_s${s}_c${CYCLE}" 0 -e memcpy_rewr -t "$(( $(DUR_S "$T_L5") / 4 ))s" "${FLAGS[@]}"
    done
    unset SANDSTONE_STRATEGY_INDEX
    # 大 mdim 档（内存预算守卫：NPROC/2 线程，scratch ≤ MemAvailable/2）
    local n64 m
    n64=$(( NPROC / 2 ))
    m=$(max_mdim_for_threads "$n64")
    [ "$m" -gt 2048 ] && m=2048
    [ "$m" -lt 2048 ] && log "L5 NUMA: mdim 2048 超内存预算，降档 mdim=$m"
    run_sdc "l5_numa_mdim${m}_c${CYCLE}" 0 -e openblas_dgemm -O "openblas_dgemm.mdim=$m" -n "$n64" \
        -t "$(( $(DUR_S "$T_L5") / 4 ))s" "${FLAGS[@]}"
}

l5_per_domain() {
    [ -z "$L5_SUITE" ] && { log "L5 逐域：无套件，跳过"; return; }
    # 事件 #1 取证实测：pN 拓扑语法在本板匹配 0 个 CPU（PPTT 伪影 package ID=36/8442
    # 而非 0/1；范围 0-31 亦不可解析）——改用 sysfs node cpulist 展开的逗号列表
    local n cs i=0
    for n in /sys/devices/system/node/node*; do
        cs=$(python3 -c "

#!/bin/bash
# watch_events.sh — SDC 战役事件看守（退出即通知, 由后台任务机制唤醒会话）
# 退出码: 0=扫描完成 1=发现fail 2=高温 3=战役事件 4=扫描进程消失(异常)
SCAN_DIR="$1"
[ -z "$SCAN_DIR" ] && { echo "用法: watch_events.sh <scan_dir>"; exit 9; }
while :; do
    f=$(grep -l "result: fail" "$SCAN_DIR"/core_*.yaml 2>/dev/null | head -3)
    if [ -n "$f" ]; then echo "FAIL-DETECTED:"; echo "$f"; exit 1; fi
    if [ -f "$SCAN_DIR/matrix.tsv" ]; then echo "SCAN-COMPLETE: $SCAN_DIR"; exit 0; fi
    t=$(cat /sys/class/thermal/thermal_zone*/temp 2>/dev/null | sort -n | tail -1)
    [ "${t:-0}" -ge 85000 ] && { echo "HIGH-TEMP: ${t}mC"; exit 2; }
    evs=$(ls ~/sdc-excite-reproduce/events/ 2>/dev/null | grep -c . )
    [ "${evs:-0}" -gt 0 ] && { echo "CAMPAIGN-EVENT: $evs 个事件目录"; ls -t ~/sdc-excite-reproduce/events/ | head -3; exit 3; }
    pgrep -f "sdc-run.sh scan" >/dev/null || { sleep 60
        pgrep -f "sdc-run.sh scan" >/dev/null || { echo "SCAN-PROCESS-GONE(且无matrix)"; exit 4; }; }
    sleep 60
done

content.text:
Base directory for this skill: /home/sdc/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/superpowers/6.4.1/skills/writing-plans

# Writing Plans

## Overview

Write comprehensive implementation plans assuming the engineer has zero context for our codebase and questionable taste. Document everything they need to know: which files to touch for each task, code, testing, docs they might need to check, how to test it. Give them the whole plan as bite-sized tasks. DRY. YAGNI. TDD. Frequent commits.

Assume they are a skilled developer, but know almost nothing about our toolset or problem domain. Assume they don't know good test design very well.

**Announce at start:** "I'm using the writing-plans skill to create the implementation plan."

**Context:** If working in an isolated worktree, it should have been created via the `superpowers:using-git-worktrees` skill at execution time.

**Save plans to:** `docs/superpowers/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<feature-name>.md`
- (User preferences for plan location override this default)

## Scope Check

If the spec covers multiple independent subsystems, it should have been broken into sub-project specs during brainstorming. If it wasn't, suggest breaking this into separate plans — one per subsystem. Each plan should produce working, testable software on its own.

## File Structure

Before defining tasks, map out which files will be created or modified and what each one is responsible for. This is where decomposition decisions get locked in.

- Design units with clear boundaries and well-defined interfaces. Each file should have one clear responsibility.
- You reason best about code you can hold in context at once, and your edits are more reliable when files are focused. Prefer smaller, focused files over large ones that do too much.
- Files that change together should live together. Split by responsibility, not by technical layer.
- In existing codebases, follow established patterns. If the codebase uses large files, don't unilaterally restructure - but if a file you're modifying has grown unwieldy, including a split in the plan is reasonable.

This structure informs the task decomposition. Each task should produce self-contained changes that make sense independently.

## Task Right-Sizing

A task is the smallest unit that carries its own test cycle and is worth a
fresh reviewer's gate. When drawing task boundaries: fold setup,
configuration, scaffolding, and documentation steps into the task whose
deliverable needs them; split only where a reviewer could meaningfully
reject one task while approving its neighbor. Each task ends with an
independently testable deliverable.

## Bite-Sized Task Granularity

**Each step is one action (2-5 minutes):**
- "Write the failing test" - step
- "Run it to make sure it fails" - step
- "Implement the minimal code to make the test pass" - step
- "Run the tests and make sure they pass" - step
- "Commit" - step

## Plan Document Header

**Every plan MUST start with this header:**

```markdown
# [Feature Name] Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** [One sentence describing what this builds]

**Architecture:** [2-3 sentences about approach]

**Tech Stack:** [Key technologies/libraries]

**Spec:** [path to the spec/design doc this plan implements — the plan
argues from the spec, so the spec travels with it; executors read both]

## Global Constraints

[The spec's project-wide requirements — version floors, dependency limits,
naming and copy rules, platform requirements — one line each, with exact
values copied verbatim from the spec. Every task's requirements implicitly
include this section.]

## Review Focus

[The five input classes or failure modes the spec implies but no task's
tests exercise that are most likely to bite a person using this software
— one line each, naming the input or condition and the behavior a
reasonable person would expect, most likely first. The spec is a vision
document: it says what the software must do, not everything it will
meet, and its silence on an input is not permission for that input to
break the program. Write the list here, once, with the spec in front of
you. Then, for each line, add the test that pins it to the task that
owns the code, in that task's own step style.]

---
```

## Task Structure

````markdown
### Task N: [Component Name]

**Files:**
- Create: `exact/path/to/file.py`
- Modify: `exact/path/to/existing.py:123-145`
- Test: `tests/exact/path/to/test.py`

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: [what this task uses from earlier tasks — exact signatures]
- Produces: [what later tasks rely on — exact function names, parameter
  and return types. A task's implementer sees only their own task; this
  block is how they learn the names and types neighboring tasks use.]

- [ ] **Step 1: Write the failing test**

```python
def test_specific_behavior():
    result = function(input)
    assert result == expected
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Run test to verify it fails**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: FAIL with "function not defined"

- [ ] **Step 3: Write minimal implementation**

```python
def function(input):
    return expected
```

- [ ] **Step 4: Run test to verify it passes**

Run: `pytest tests/path/test.py::test_name -v`
Expected: PASS

- [ ] **Step 5: Commit**

```bash
git add tests/path/test.py src/path/file.py
git commit -m "feat: add specific feature"
```
````

## No Placeholders

Every step must contain the actual content an engineer needs. These are **plan failures** — never write them:
- "TBD", "TODO", "implement later", "fill in details"
- "Add appropriate error handling" / "add validation" / "handle edge cases"
- "Write tests for the above" (without actual test code)
- "Similar to Task N" (repeat the code — the engineer may be reading tasks out of order)
- Steps that describe what to do without showing how (code blocks required for code steps)
- References to types, functions, or methods not defined in any task

## Self-Review

After writing the complete plan, look at the spec with fresh eyes and check the plan against it. This is a checklist you run yourself — not a subagent dispatch.

**1. Spec coverage:** Skim each section/requirement in the spec. Can you point to a task that implements it? List any gaps.

**2. Placeholder scan:** Search your plan for red flags — any of the patterns from the "No Placeholders" section above. Fix them.

**3. Type consistency:** Do the types, method signatures, and property names you used in later tasks match what you defined in earlier tasks? A function called `clearLayers()` in Task 3 but `clearFullLayers()` in Task 7 is a bug.

**4. Review Focus:** For each input class or failure mode the spec implies, is there a task whose tests exercise it? The five uncovered ones most likely to bite a person go in the Review Focus section, and each line there gets its test added to the owning task. An empty section means you checked and found none, not that you skipped the check.

If you find issues, fix them inline. No need to re-review — just fix and move on. If you find a spec requirement with no task, add the task.

## Execution Handoff

After saving and self-reviewing the plan, link it for your human partner
to read. If they have already explicitly supplied an execution method, ask
them to review the plan and confirm it captures what they want; wait for that
review before implementation, then use the preserved method. Otherwise, ask
them to review the plan and choose an execution method before implementation.

**When no execution method has already been supplied:**

**"Plan complete and saved to `docs/superpowers/plans/<filename>.md`. Please review the plan. Which execution approach would you prefer?**

- **Subagent-driven** - A fresh subagent implements each task and a fresh reviewer checks it before the next one starts, then a whole-branch review at the end. Most thorough; costs a fresh context per task and per review.
- **Native** - I implement every task myself in this session, the way this harness runs work, then one fresh reviewer on the most capable model checks the whole branch. Cheapest and fastest; no independent review until the end. Runs well with a mid-tier session model, since the plan carries the design.

**For this plan I recommend <one of the two>, because <one sentence from the plan: how much the tasks depend on each other's interfaces, how many there are, what a shipped mistake would cost>. Does the plan capture what you want, and which approach should we use?"**

**When an execution method has already been supplied:**

# 战役引擎参数最大化强化 Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 把 2026-10-16 实测标定的内存最大化参数注入 sdc-excite-reproduce.sh 战役引擎的 eigen 单线程段与 L4 驻留段，使 7×24 战役的向量/浮点用例压力按"当前内存容量最大化"运行。

**Architecture:** 引擎是 bash 状态机（cycle 内 cold→l2→l3→l5→l4 顺序阶段）。本 patch 只改两个阶段的参数装配，不改状态机结构：(1) `phase_l3` 的 eigen 单线程段（`-n 1`，单线程形态，吃大 mdim）注入 3 个 `-O` 覆盖并把调度量子从 60s 提到 260s 以容纳 ~100s/迭代的大矩阵 SVD；(2) `phase_l4` 驻留循环对 `openblas_dgemm` 满核驻留注入 mdim=1536（满核安全上限）。T_EIGEN 预算 300s→900s 让量子提升后仍能覆盖多个 eigen 用例。

**Tech Stack:** bash（引擎脚本）、sdcshield `-O test.knob=v` 运行时参数链（sdc_knob_int_clamped，越界自动 clamp 不报错）。

**Spec:** 本 plan 自带标定数据（2026-10-16 本机实测，TaiShan 2280 / Kunpeng 920 / 126 核在线 / 28G 可用）。上游目标：用户 goal"根据当前内存容量最大化所有用例的参数（尤其向量、浮点如 eigen）"。

## Global Constraints

- 满核（126 线程）形态安全上限（实测 MemAvailable 低点，2026-10-16）：`eigen_svd_double.mdim=1024`（1536=OOM 26G 打满）、`eigen_gemm_double_dynamic_square.mdim=2048`（17G 峰值）、`openblas_dgemm.mdim=1536`（2048 已 23G，与伴层叠加超界）。
- 单线程（-n 1 / --cpuset）形态实测：`eigen_svd_double.mdim=2048` → RSS 558MB、迭代 99.7s；`eigen_gemm_double_dynamic_square.mdim=4096` → 1.03GiB、64s；`openblas_dgemm.mdim=4096` → 1.17GiB、65s（4096 是 eigen_gemm clamp 上限 [16,4096]，svd clamp 上限 [64,2048]）。
- 调度量子必须 ≥ 2×单次迭代时长，否则窗口内完不成比对（无压力意义）：svd@2048 需量子 ≥ 200s，取 260s。
- `-O` 对 clamp 范围外的值静默截断到界内（sdc_knob_int_clamped 语义），对不在 `-e` 列表的测试无副作用。
- x86-64 不受影响（引擎脚本是 ARM64 部署侧运维脚本，不触碰 x86 测试代码）。
- 引擎脚本修改后必须 `bash -n` 语法校验；行为验证不能跑全量 smoke（会与在跑的 scan 抢 CPU），用等价单命令实测。

## Review Focus

- `-O` 旋钮名拼错 → sdc_knob 静默用默认值，参数注入无声失效。测试步骤必须断言实测迭代时长/内存与标定值同量级（mdim 生效的证据），而非仅看 pass。
- 量子 260s 与 T_EIGEN 预算的相对关系：预算必须 ≥ 单量子，否则 run_bounded 的 `-T` 先到，首个测试被中途掐断。900s ≥ 260s ✓。
- L4 驻留段 `-t each`（each=remain/n，可达数小时）与 `--max-test-loop-count=0` 的固定模式：注入 mdim 后单迭代时长变长（oblas@1536 满核 ~10s 级），不影响固定模式语义。
- DWELL_OVERRIDE 事件驱动切换（事件测试优先驻留）：条件注入必须只匹配 `openblas_dgemm` 精确名，不能把 oblas 的 -O 带给事件测试。
- smoke 模式回归：T_EIGEN 在 smoke 档是 30s，量子若全局改 260s 会让 smoke 的 eigen 段单测试跑 260s（-t 260s）超预算——需确认 smoke 不跑出 hang 判定（run_bounded 的 timeout 兜底 = 预算+量子+120s = 410s，安全）。

---

### Task 1: l3_eigen_n1 段参数最大化注入 + T_EIGEN 延长

**Files:**
- Modify: `scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/sdc-excite-reproduce.sh:23`（T_EIGEN=300s → 900s，full 档）
- Modify: `scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/sdc-excite-reproduce.sh:315`（eigen_n1 段量子与 -O 注入）

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `run_bounded <label> <预算秒> <单测量子秒> <args...>`（本文件既有）、`resolve 'eigen*'`（既有）、`FLAGS` 数组（既有）。
- Produces: `l3_eigen_n1_c${CYCLE}` 波次命令含 `-O eigen_svd_double.mdim=2048 -O eigen_svd_double2.mdim=2048 -O eigen_gemm_double_dynamic_square.mdim=4096`；Task 2 的验证复用本任务的标定断言方法。

- [ ] **Step 1: 修改 T_EIGEN full 档**

`scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/sdc-excite-reproduce.sh:23`，把：

```bash
    T_HEAT=30m;  T_TARGET=30m; T_EIGEN=300s
```

改为：

```bash
    T_HEAT=30m;  T_TARGET=30m; T_EIGEN=900s
```

（只动 full 档行 23；smoke 档行 18 的 `T_EIGEN=30s` 不动。）

- [ ] **Step 2: 修改 l3_eigen_n1 段**

同文件 `phase_l3()` 内，把：

```bash
    [ -n "$eig" ] && run_bounded "l3_eigen_n1_c${CYCLE}" "$(DUR_S "$T_EIGEN")" 60 -e "$eig" -n 1 "${FLAGS[@]}"
```

改为：

```bash
    # eigen 单线程大参数档（2026-10-16 标定: svd@2048=558MB/99.7s迭代, gemm@4096=1.03G/64s;
    # 量子 260s 保 ≥2 次完整迭代——60s 量子在 100s 迭代下零比对, 大参数形同虚设）
    [ -n "$eig" ] && run_bounded "l3_eigen_n1_c${CYCLE}" "$(DUR_S "$T_EIGEN")" 260 -e "$eig" -n 1 \
        -O eigen_svd_double.mdim=2048 -O eigen_svd_double2.mdim=2048 \
        -O eigen_gemm_double_dynamic_square.mdim=4096 "${FLAGS[@]}"
```

- [ ] **Step 3: 语法校验**

Run: `bash -n scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/sdc-excite-reproduce.sh`
Expected: 无输出，退出码 0。

- [ ] **Step 4: 行为实测（等价命令形态，绕开与在跑 scan 的 CPU 冲突——单线程绑定核 8）**

Run:

```bash
/usr/bin/time -v ./builddir/sdcshield --cpuset=8 -t 260s -Y --quality=0 \
  -e eigen_svd_double -O eigen_svd_double.mdim=2048 -o /tmp/eng_patch_svd.yaml \
  > /tmp/eng_patch_svd.log 2>&1
grep -E 'test-runtime|result' /tmp/eng_patch_svd.yaml | head -4
```

Expected: `test-runtime` ≈ 100000ms 量级（mdim=2048 生效证据——默认自适应约 511 维时单迭代 <15s）；`result: pass`。

- [ ] **Step 5: zstd19 回归（CLAUDE.md 标准）**

Run: `./builddir/sdcshield -e zstd19 -t 2000 -n 1`
Expected: `exit: pass`。

- [ ] **Step 6: 提交**

```bash
git add scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/sdc-excite-reproduce.sh
git commit -s -m 'feat(excite): eigen 单线程段参数最大化——svd mdim 2048/gemm 4096 + 量子 260s

2026-10-16 标定(126核/28G): svd@2048 单线程 558MB/99.7s 迭代, gemm@4096 1.03G/64s。
60s 量子下 100s 迭代零比对, 量子提至 260s 保 ≥2 次完整迭代; T_EIGEN 300s→900s
覆盖提升后的单量子。满核形态安全上限(svd1024/gemm2048)不变, L3 满核段不注入。'
```

### Task 2: L4 驻留段 openblas_dgemm 满核参数化

**Files:**
- Modify: `scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/sdc-excite-reproduce.sh`（`phase_l4()` 驻留循环）

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: `phase_l4()` 既有结构（DWELL_DEFAULT 列表迭代 + `run_sdc` + `--max-test-loop-count=0` 固定模式）；Task 1 的标定断言方法。
- Produces: `l4_dwell_openblas_dgemm_c${CYCLE}` 波次满核 mdim=1536 驻留（实测 13G 量级峰值预估，来自 oblas@2048=23G 的平方比例外推）。

- [ ] **Step 1: 修改驻留循环**

`phase_l4()` 内，把：

```bash
    for t in "${arr[@]}"; do
        run_sdc "l4_dwell_${t}_c${CYCLE}" 0 -e "$t" -t "${each}s" --max-test-loop-count=0 "${FLAGS[@]}"
    done
```

改为：

```bash
    for t in "${arr[@]}"; do
        # 满核驻留大参数档（2026-10-16 标定: oblas mdim=2048 满核峰值 23G 与伴层叠加
        # 超界, 降档 1536 ≈13G; 条件注入——DWELL_OVERRIDE 事件测试不带 oblas 参数）
        local o=()
        [ "$t" = "openblas_dgemm" ] && o=(-O openblas_dgemm.mdim=1536)
        run_sdc "l4_dwell_${t}_c${CYCLE}" 0 -e "$t" -t "${each}s" --max-test-loop-count=0 "${o[@]}" "${FLAGS[@]}"
    done
```

（bash 函数内 `local` 在循环体内合法；若 lint 偏好，可把 `local o` 提到循环前——两可，保持最小 diff 用循环内声明。）

- [ ] **Step 2: 语法校验**

Run: `bash -n scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/sdc-excite-reproduce.sh`
Expected: 无输出，退出码 0。

- [ ] **Step 3: 行为实测（满核 oblas@1536 短跑验证峰值与 pass——90s）**

Run:

```bash
( while :; do awk '/MemAvailable/{print $2; fflush()}' /proc/meminfo; sleep 0.3; done > /tmp/eng_patch_oblas_mem.txt ) & S=$!
./builddir/sdcshield -t 90s -Y --quality=0 -e openblas_dgemm -O openblas_dgemm.mdim=1536 -o /tmp/eng_patch_oblas.yaml > /tmp/eng_patch_oblas.log 2>&1
kill $S 2>/dev/null
sort -n /tmp/eng_patch_oblas_mem.txt | head -1
grep -cE 'result: pass' /tmp/eng_patch_oblas.yaml
```

Expected: MemAvailable 低点 > 8GiB（预估占用 ~13G，留伴层余量）；pass 计数 ≥ 1；无 crash。

注意：此满核实测与在跑 scan 并存时总内存 = scan(~19G 峰值) + oblas(~13G) 会超界——**必须在 scan 完成后执行本步**，或临时把 scan 的内存余量计入（若 scan 未完成则等待巡检确认 matrix.tsv 出现后再跑）。执行顺序由整体战役时序保证。

- [ ] **Step 4: zstd19 回归**

Run: `./builddir/sdcshield -e zstd19 -t 2000 -n 1`
Expected: `exit: pass`。

- [ ] **Step 5: 提交**

```bash
git add scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/sdc-excite-reproduce.sh
git commit -s -m 'feat(excite): L4 驻留 openblas_dgemm 满核 mdim 1536——驻留段参数最大化

2026-10-16 标定: oblas mdim 2048 满核峰值 23G(MemAvailable 低点 3.9G)与 mem_saturate
伴层叠加超界, 降档 1536(≈13G, 平方比例外推 2048 实测 23G)。条件注入精确匹配
openblas_dgemm——DWELL_OVERRIDE 事件驱动切换时不携带。'
```

### Task 3: 引擎恢复启动（战役重启）

**Files:**
- 无代码修改。操作任务：scan 完成后启动强化版引擎 + mem_saturate。

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 1/2 的引擎代码；`~/sdc-excite-reproduce/state.json`（cycle 断点——引擎重启后从 state 的 cycle+1 开始新循环）；巡检 cron（ecb42ac8）负责在 scan 完成时触发本任务。
- Produces: 7×24 战役运行态（引擎 + 三伴层 + 巡检 cron + scan 看守）。

- [ ] **Step 1: 确认 scan 完成且无未决事件**

Run: `ls /home/sdc/sdc-run/scan-maxparam-1016-2150/matrix.tsv`（巡检 cron 已在每次触发时检查）
Expected: 存在；`report.md` 无未定性 fail（已知噪声表排除后）。

- [ ] **Step 2: 启动引擎（强化版）**

```bash
cd /home/sdc/wangxu/sdcshield
nohup bash scripts/sdc-excite-reproduce/sdc-excite-reproduce.sh full >> ~/sdc-excite-reproduce/driver.log 2>&1 & disown
```

- [ ] **Step 3: 启动 mem_saturate（内存拉满伴层）**

```bash
nohup bash ~/sdc-run/mem_saturate.sh >> ~/sdc-run/mem_saturate.log 2>&1 & disown
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 验证三件套运行态**

Run: `pgrep -a -f 'sdc-excite-reproduce.sh|mem_saturate.sh|cpu_backfill.sh|user_monitor.sh' | grep -v pgrep; tail -3 ~/sdc-excite-reproduce/driver.log`
Expected: 4 个进程在列；driver.log 尾部为 `战役启动 mode=full ... cycle起点=...`；3 分钟后 free -g 显示内存被逐步拉满。

---

## 验证边界诚实声明

- 引擎 `full` 模式全链路（cold 30m → l2 → l3 6h → l5 → l4 至 07:30）无法在本次会话内完整端到端验证——验证到"新参数形态的等价单命令实测 + 语法校验 + zstd19 回归"为止，全链路行为由 7×24 巡检持续确认（driver.log 波次行 + 巡检 cron）。
- 本 patch 不触碰 x86-64 测试代码（引擎脚本是部署侧运维脚本，per-arch 隔离不受影响）。

- `-O` 旋钮名拼错 → sdc_knob 静默用默认值，参数注入无声失效。测试步骤必须断言实测迭代时长/内存与标定值同量级（mdim 生效的证据），而非仅看 pass。

content.text:
Base directory for this skill: /home/sdc/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/superpowers/6.4.1/skills/executing-plans

# Executing Plans

Execute the plan yourself, task by task, in this session: no implementer
subagent per task, no reviewer per task. One fresh-context review of the
whole branch at the end.

**Why inline:** Subagent-driven development pays for a fresh implementer
and a fresh reviewer on every task, each re-reading the codebase from zero.
Inline execution pays for one context (yours) plus one reviewer at the end.
What it gives up is a fresh context per task and a second pair of eyes per
task. This skill keeps what those two things bought, by other means: the
brief is the spec, the ledger is your memory, TDD is the per-task gate, and
the final reviewer is the second pair of eyes.

**Core principle:** The plan already did the thinking. Execute it exactly,
prove each step with a test you watched fail and then pass, and leave a
record that survives your own forgetting.

**Narration:** between tool calls, narrate at most one short line — the
ledger and the tool results carry the record.

**Continuous execution:** Do not pause to check in with your human partner
between tasks. They chose inline execution to spend less, not to answer
"should I continue?" after every task. Execute all tasks from the plan
without stopping.

**Rulings, not stalls.** Conflicts, ambiguities, plan defects — decide them.
The spec is the binding authority, the plan is its argument, and your
judgment settles what neither answers. Record every decision in the ledger
as `Ruling: <what you decided> — <why> — <what it costs if wrong>`, and keep
going. Deviating from the plan without a ledgered ruling is a decision made
in secret.

Four things stop you, and only these: an irreversible or destructive
operation; a security-sensitive action; a side effect outside this worktree
that norms say you ask about first (a merge, a push to a shared branch, a
publish); and a plan so broken that every path forward is a guess. For
those, stop and ask.

## When to Use

- You have a plan from superpowers:writing-plans and your human partner
  chose inline execution at the handoff.
- Your harness has no subagent tool (see the per-platform references in
  `../using-superpowers/references/`). Never fabricate a dispatch; run
  the plan here.
- Tasks are mostly independent — the same precondition as
  superpowers:subagent-driven-development.

A fully specified plan makes inline execution transcription plus testing:
it runs well on a mid-tier session model, and the one place the most
capable model earns its cost is the final review, which this skill
dispatches separately. Tell your human partner so when they choose inline.

Prefer superpowers:subagent-driven-development when your human partner
wants a review gate on every task, or when the plan is long enough that
its later tasks would run on a compacted context. Inline execution over a
long plan still works — the ledger is what makes it recoverable — but the
last tasks get the least of you.

## The Process

```dot
digraph process {
    rankdir=TB;

    subgraph cluster_per_task {
        label="Per Task";
        "task-start: brief + BASE; read the brief" [shape=box];
        "Work the steps in order: TDD, run every verification, read every output" [shape=box];
        "Step output matches plan's Expected?" [shape=diamond];
        "Plan wrong? Rule and ledger. Code wrong? systematic-debugging" [shape=box];
        "Commit as the plan's commit steps say" [shape=box];
        "Completion contract met?" [shape=diamond];
        "task-done: run tests, ledger the result; mark todo complete" [shape=box];
    }

    "Setup: worktree, workspace + ledger, read plan + spec, pre-flight scan" [shape=box];
    "More tasks remain?" [shape=diamond];
    "Final whole-branch review (fresh reviewer if you have one)" [shape=box];
    "Re-grade, then: Critical/Important → ONE fix pass, each fix RED→GREEN + green suite; Minor → ledger" [shape=box];
    "Final review clean: delete this plan's workspace" [shape=box];
    "Use superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch" [shape=box style=filled fillcolor=lightgreen];

    "Setup: worktree, workspace + ledger, read plan + spec, pre-flight scan" -> "task-start: brief + BASE; read the brief";
    "task-start: brief + BASE; read the brief" -> "Work the steps in order: TDD, run every verification, read every output";
    "Work the steps in order: TDD, run every verification, read every output" -> "Step output matches plan's Expected?";
    "Step output matches plan's Expected?" -> "Plan wrong? Rule and ledger. Code wrong? systematic-debugging" [label="no"];
    "Plan wrong? Rule and ledger. Code wrong? systematic-debugging" -> "Work the steps in order: TDD, run every verification, read every output";
    "Step output matches plan's Expected?" -> "Commit as the plan's commit steps say" [label="yes, last step"];
    "Commit as the plan's commit steps say" -> "Completion contract met?";
    "Completion contract met?" -> "Work the steps in order: TDD, run every verification, read every output" [label="no - finish the task"];
    "Completion contract met?" -> "task-done: run tests, ledger the result; mark todo complete" [label="yes"];
    "task-done: run tests, ledger the result; mark todo complete" -> "More tasks remain?";
    "More tasks remain?" -> "task-start: brief + BASE; read the brief" [label="yes"];
    "More tasks remain?" -> "Final whole-branch review (fresh reviewer if you have one)" [label="no"];
    "Final whole-branch review (fresh reviewer if you have one)" -> "Re-grade, then: Critical/Important → ONE fix pass, each fix RED→GREEN + green suite; Minor → ledger";
    "Re-grade, then: Critical/Important → ONE fix pass, each fix RED→GREEN + green suite; Minor → ledger" -> "Final review clean: delete this plan's workspace";
    "Final review clean: delete this plan's workspace" -> "Use superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch";
}
```

## Setup

Ensure the work happens in an isolated workspace: use
superpowers:using-git-worktrees to create one or verify the existing one.
Never start implementation on a main/master branch without your human
partner's explicit consent.

Conversation memory does not survive compaction. An inline executor that
loses its place re-implements tasks whose commits already exist — the same
failure as a controller re-dispatching them, paid for in your own context.
Track progress in a ledger file, not only in todos. Harness todos are a
live view; the ledger is the record.

The workspace and ledger are shared with superpowers:subagent-driven-development
— same directory, same format — so a plan can change executors mid-flight
and the new one resumes from the same ledger.

- Each plan owns a workspace: at skill start, run
  `../subagent-driven-development/scripts/sdd-workspace PLAN_FILE` — it
  prints the plan's git-ignored directory
  (`<repo-root>/.superpowers/sdd/<plan-basename>/`), home to every
  artifact for THIS plan: ledger, briefs, review packages. Another plan's
  directory is never yours to read or write.
- Check for this plan's ledger at `<workspace>/progress.md`. If its first
  line names your plan file, tasks with a `Task <N>: complete` line are
  DONE — do not redo them; resume at the first task without one. Their
  commits exist in git even when your context no longer remembers making
  them: after compaction, trust the ledger and `git log` over your own
  recollection. A ledger whose first line names a different plan file is
  another plan's progress: leave it and start your own, fresh.
- Create the ledger with its identity as the first line:
  `# SDD ledger — plan: <plan file path>`.
- `git clean -fdx` will destroy the workspace (it's git-ignored scratch);
  if that happens, recover from `git log`.

Read the plan once, note its context and Global Constraints, and create a
todo per task. If the plan names a Spec, read that too: the spec is the
authority the plan argues from, and conflicts inside the plan resolve
against it. A plan with no reachable spec gets a ledger note saying so —
rulings made without one are provisional.

**REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** load superpowers:test-driven-development now,
before Task 1. It governs every step of every task below; a plan whose
steps already say "write the failing test first" does not exempt you
from reading it.

Before Task 1, scan the plan for conflicts between tasks. The plan's
Interfaces blocks tell you where to look: for every task that consumes
what an earlier task produces, one ledger row — the two tasks, what one
produces against what the other consumes, and what you found. Tasks that
share nothing get no row; a plan whose tasks share nothing gets the single
line `Pre-flight: no shared interfaces`. Rule on each conflict a row
surfaces with the spec as the binding authority, record the ruling beside
its row, and start Task 1. Each task's own text is checked when you read
its brief, not here.

## The Task Loop

Everything you print, and every tool result, stays resident in your
context for the rest of the session. Redirect long test output to a file
in the workspace and read its tail; read a brief, not the whole plan.

### 1. Take the task

- Run this skill's `scripts/task-start PLAN_FILE N`. It prints the brief
  path and BASE (the commit the task's range is cut from) in one call.
  Read the brief for every task, including ones you remember from setup:
  what you remember is a summary, the brief has the exact values,
  signatures, and test cases.
- Mark the task's todo in_progress.

Every tool call is a turn that re-reads your whole context. Bookkeeping
rides along with work — a ledger append in the same call as the commit,
never in a call of its own.

### 2. Work the steps

The plan's steps are already in RED-GREEN order; follow them in that
order under superpowers:test-driven-development, loaded at setup. A test
step's code is written first and run first. Watching it fail is a step,
not a formality — a test that passes before the implementation exists is
a finding about the test.

Every step that runs a command has an `Expected:` line. Run the command,
read its output, and compare. Three outcomes:

- **Matches.** Next step.
- **The code is wrong.** Use superpowers:systematic-debugging. Find the
  cause; never patch the symptom to make the step's output match.
- **The plan is wrong** — a step contradicts the spec, an interface from an
  earlier task doesn't match what this task consumes, a command that
  cannot work. Rule on the smallest change that satisfies the spec, ledger
  it as `Task <N>: Ruling: <finding> — <what you decided and why>`, and
  continue. The ruling is carried, not remembered: later tasks that touch
  the same interface read it from the ledger.

Commit as the plan's commit steps say. A task that spans several commits
is fine; BASE is what the review range is cut from, never `HEAD~1`.

### 3. The completion contract

Before a task's ledger line, all of the following are true, with evidence
in this session — not inferred from the diff looking right:

- Every test the brief names exists and ran in this task, and you read
  the output.
- The final test run for the task passed — `task-done` is that run, and
  it writes the command and result into the ledger line.
- Every `Expected:` line in the brief was compared against real output.
- Every deviation from the brief has a `Ruling:` line in the ledger.

**REQUIRED SUB-SKILL:** superpowers:verification-before-completion governs
the claim. If any item is missing, the task is not complete: finish it.

### 4. Complete the task

Run this skill's `scripts/task-done PLAN_FILE N BASE -- <test command>`
with the test command the brief names for the whole task. It runs the
tests, keeps the full output in the workspace, prints the tail, and — only
if they pass — appends the completion line to the ledger:

`Task <N>: complete (commits <base7>..<head7>, tests: <command> → <result>)`

A failing run records nothing; the task is not complete. When it records,
mark the todo complete and take the next task.

## Final Review

Run `../subagent-driven-development/scripts/review-package PLAN_FILE MERGE_BASE HEAD`
(MERGE_BASE = the commit the branch started from, e.g.
`git merge-base main HEAD`) and review from the file it prints.

**With a subagent tool:** dispatch the reviewer on the most capable
available model — the whole-branch review is a judgment task — using
superpowers:requesting-code-review's
[code-reviewer.md](../requesting-code-review/code-reviewer.md), with the
package path, the plan and spec paths, the plan's Review Focus section
verbatim if it has one (the input classes and failure modes the plan's
tests do not exercise — the reviewer checks each deliberately), and a
pointer to the ledger's `Ruling:` lines so it can weigh the calls you
made. Specify the model
explicitly; an omitted model inherits the session's, which may not be the
most capable. This is the one fresh context the whole run buys. Do not
skip it, and do not replace it with your own read of the diff.

**Without a subagent tool:** read code-reviewer.md and perform that review
yourself against the package, as a separate pass after the last task's
ledger line. Write `Final review: self-review (no subagent tool)` to the
ledger, and say so in your final message: a self-review by the author is
weaker than a fresh reviewer, and your human partner decides whether that
is enough before merge.

Sort the findings before you act on any of them. The reviewer's severity
labels are advice; the gate is yours. Its "Declined to judge" list is
yours too: every line there is a ruling you make and ledger, exactly like
a plan conflict — `Final: Ruling: <behavior the reviewer set aside> —
<what a reasonable person using this software gets, and why that stands
or why it is now a finding> — <cost if wrong>`. Re-grade first, by effect: the
spec is a vision document, and a finding's grade is what a reasonable
person using this software gets if it ships, not whether the spec names
the input that triggers it — a reviewer who set a finding at Minor
because the spec was silent has graded the spec, not the effect. Then:

- **Critical and Important** enter the fix pass.
- **Minor** goes to the ledger as `Final: minor (deferred): <one-liner>`
  and to your final message under "Deferred minors". Minors never enter
  the fix pass, and never become rulings — a ruling is a decision about a
  conflict, not a note that you declined a polish suggestion.

Fix the Critical and Important findings yourself — you are the
implementer here — in ONE pass. Each fix is verified by TDD, not by a
second reviewer: write the test that reproduces the finding, watch it
fail, make it pass, then run the whole suite. Record each in the ledger as
`Final: fixed <finding> — <test name> RED→GREEN, suite <N>/<N>`. A fix
without a test that failed first is not verified; a suite that is not
green after the pass means the pass is not over. Do not dispatch a
re-review: it would re-read a diff whose covering tests already answer
"addressed" and whose suite run already answers "broke nothing".

A finding you decide not to fix is a ruling — `Final: Ruling: <finding> —
<why the code stands> — <cost if wrong>` — and reaches your human partner
in the rulings list. There is no second fix pass.

## Finish

Before you delete anything, collect every ledger line containing
`Ruling:` into your final message under "Rulings I made", in the order you
made them, each with what it costs if wrong, and every `minor (deferred)`
line under "Deferred minors". Both lists are exhaustive. Your final
message is the only place the decisions you took on your human partner's
behalf — and the findings you chose not to act on — reach them.

When the final review is clean and its fixes are committed, delete this
plan's workspace directory — the git history is the record now. Sibling
directories belong to other plans; leave them alone.

Use superpowers:finishing-a-development-branch.

## Common Rationalizations

| Excuse | Reality |
|--------|---------|
| "I remember what Task N says" | You remember a summary. The brief has the exact values. Read it. |
| "The plan's code is right, skip watching the test fail" | A test you never saw fail proves nothing. It is one step. Run it. |
| "I'll run the full suite at the end instead of per step" | Per-step runs are how you learn which step broke it. The end-of-task run is the contract, not a substitute. |
| "The plan is wrong here, I'll just do the right thing" | Do the right thing and ledger the ruling. Unledgered deviation is a decision made in secret. |
| "I'll write the ledger lines after a few tasks" | Compaction does not wait for a convenient moment. One line per task, in the same message as the commit. |
| "Let me check in before the next task" | They chose inline to spend less. Progress prompts spend their time instead. Only the four stops stop you. |
| "I read my own diff carefully; the final reviewer is redundant" | Same author, same blind spots. The reviewer is the only fresh context this run buys. |
| "Tests should pass, the change was trivial" | "Should" is not evidence. The contract requires the command and its output. |
| "Subagents are slow and expensive, I'll skip the final review too" | Inline already removed the per-task reviewers. One review of the whole branch is the floor, not the ceiling. |
| "The reviewer said Minor, so it's Minor" | The label graded the spec's silence. Grade what the person gets. Re-grade, then gate. |
| "The fix is obvious, no need for a failing test first" | The failing test is the only proof the finding was real and is now gone. Without it you have a diff and a hope. |
| "I'll fix the minors too while I'm in there" | Every minor you fix is a test, a fix, and a suite run your partner did not ask for. Ledger them; your partner decides. |

content.content:
* codepaths are SLEEF's newest NEON implementations.
 *
 * The per-family element count is a runtime footprint knob resolved
 * through the unified stress-config chain (priority order): "-O
 * sleef_neon.nelems=N" or a config-file entry (128..64M in multiples
 * of 4 — out-of-range values warn and clamp, non-multiples of 4 warn
 * and round down; the test-id prefix is required — a bare "nelems=N"
 * is silently ignored), the SDC_SLEEF_NEON_NELEMS environment
 * variable, or a memory-adaptive default (~32 double-equivalent linear
 * buffers per thread at 60% of physical memory) when neither is set.
 * It sweeps the replay working set across the cache hierarchy (1024:
 * a double segment's input+golden+scratch = 24KB stays L1D-resident;
 * 16384: ~384KB -> L2; 262144: 2MB per double buffer -> LLC/DRAM; see
 * the ELEMS_MIN comment for the numbers), because different cache
 * structures hold different ACE residency. Configuring nelems=1024
 * reproduces the historical compile-time ELEMS=1024 behavior exactly:
 * same RNG consumption order, byte-identical inputs/goldens; the run
 * loop's per-thread rerolls draw fresh values from the framework RNG
 * every kRerollEvery iterations — B2-006.
 * @endparblock
 */

#include <sandstone.h>
#include "sdc_stress_config.h"

#include <sleef.h>

#include <arm_neon.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>

#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================
# mem_saturate.sh — 内存饱和伴层（用户要求: CPU 与内存都满载）
#
# 自适应目标带:
#   MemAvailable > 8 GiB        → 增一个 2GiB stress-ng --vm-keep 实例
#                                （常驻触碰/重脏页，非仅分配）
#   MemAvailable < 6.5 GiB      → 缩一个实例（护住战役复测护栏 6GB 门
#                                ——复测被 memguard 拦截 = 丢 SDC 证据）
#   swap 换入换出持续非零(si/so) → 缩一个实例（swap thrash 伤确定性）
#
# 物理占用口径: stress-ng 匿名页 + 内核 page cache 自然回填 →
# 目标带内物理占用 ≈ 77-80% anon + cache 打满剩余。
# 退出: kill 主循环（trap 收全部子实例）
# ============================================================
LOGF="$HOME/sdc-run/mem_saturate.log"
PIDS=()
STEP_GB=2
GROW_AVAIL_KB=$((8*1024*1024))     # 8 GiB
SHRINK_AVAIL_KB=$((13*512*1024))   # 6.5 GiB = 6815744 kB
log() { printf '[%s] %s\n' "$(date '+%F %T')" "$*" >> "$LOGF"; }

cleanup() {
    [ ${#PIDS[@]} -gt 0 ] && kill "${PIDS[@]}" 2>/dev/null
    log "退出: 收 ${#PIDS[@]} 个内存实例"
    exit 0
}
trap cleanup INT TERM EXIT

log "mem_saturate 启动 (pid $$) 步长=${STEP_GB}GiB 目标带=[6.5,8]GiB avail"
while :; do
    ma=$(awk '/^MemAvailable/{print $2}' /proc/meminfo)
    # swap 守卫: 只看持续换出(so)——换入(si)是良性回读(2026-10-16 实测: 基线扫描
    # 超订残留页 si=172/s 持续非零, 旧守卫 si+so>0 恒触发收缩 → 伴层永不增长)
    so1=$(awk '/^pswpout/{print $2}' /proc/vmstat)
    sleep 5
    so2=$(awk '/^pswpout/{print $2}' /proc/vmstat)
    swap_out=$(( so2 - so1 ))

    if [ "$ma" -lt $((3*1024*1024)) ] && [ ${#PIDS[@]} -gt 1 ]; then
        # 危急档(avail<3GiB): 一次杀半数——2026-10-16 实测热扫描 eigen 波次叠加
        # 时 avail 瞬时到 0, 1实例/60s 常规收缩来不及, OOM 会误杀 sdcshield 制造伪事件
        half=$(( ${#PIDS[@]} / 2 ))
        kill "${PIDS[@]:0:$half}" 2>/dev/null
        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]:$half}")
        log "危急收缩: 杀 $half → ${#PIDS[@]} 个 (avail=${ma}kB)"
    elif [ "$swap_out" -gt 200 ] || [ "$ma" -lt "$SHRINK_AVAIL_KB" ]; then
        if [ ${#PIDS[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
            kill "${PIDS[${#PIDS[@]}-1]}" 2>/dev/null
            unset "PIDS[${#PIDS[@]}-1]"
            log "缩 1 实例 → ${#PIDS[@]} 个 (avail=${ma}kB swap_out=${swap_out}/5s)"
        fi
    elif [ "$ma" -gt "$GROW_AVAIL_KB" ]; then
        stress-ng --vm 1 --vm-bytes "${STEP_GB}g" --vm-keep --vm-method all \
            --metrics-brief >> "$LOGF" 2>&1 &
        PIDS+=($!)
        log "增 1 实例 → ${#PIDS[@]} 个 (avail=${ma}kB)"
    fi
    sleep 55
done


尾块处理：当 `end - ptr` 非零（1..15 字节残留）时，`memcpy(end - sizeof(v), &v, sizeof(v))` 写 **16 字节到 end-16** —— 但 end-ptr < 16 时，end-16 < ptr，写越界到 ptr 之前的区域！

等等——end-16 落在 [ptr-15, ptr+0) 区间？不对：end - ptr = r（1..15），end - 16 = ptr + r - 16 ∈ [ptr-15, ptr-1]。**越界写 ptr 之前的 16-r 字节**！这会破坏该缓冲区前面的堆数据（前一个字段/堆元数据）。

sm3sm4 的 data_size 上限应按"单迭代 ≤ 量子/2"预算。60s 量子 → 迭代 ≤30s → 首迭代冷启 ~2×稳态 → 稳态 ≤15s → data_size ≤ ~6M（8.9s/4M 线性 → 2M=4.5s, 4M=9s, 6M=13.5s）。但首迭代 128s（4M）是竞争环境（scan+backfill 满载）——引擎环境 backfill nice10 会好些但 60s 量子下 4M 首迭代还是可能 >60s。
保守：**引擎 L3 给 sm3sm4 固定 data_size=1048576（1M，~2.2s/迭代稳态）**——120s 量子内 ~50 迭代，60s 量子 ~25 迭代，有效压力 + 零超时。
  
1M 的检出价值：SM4-CBC 全链路（加密/解密/摘要）都跑，迭代深度足够。✓

这需要引擎 patch（Task 1 的 eigen_n1 -O 之外，给 l3_fixed/l3_rand 加 -O openssl_sm3sm4.data_size=1048576）。或者改 sm_data_size 的自适应（框架代码）——更大动作。**最小正确动作：引擎层固定**。作为 plan 的补充任务（Task 2b）并入 Task 2 提交？不——CLAUDE.md 一 patch 一 unit。独立小 patch：Task 2b。

等等，还要查 L3_DISABLE 当前怎么处理 sm3sm4 的——上轮战役 sm3sm4 全核 fail，state.json 的 phase_cmd 没有 --disable sm3sm4，所以上轮它确实在 L3 里翻车。我加 -O 固定 1M 即可（不用 disable——保留其 SDC 检出能力）。

patch 位置：phase_l3 的 dis 构造后，run_bounded 调用加 -O。l3_fixed 和 l3_rand 两个调用都要加。

写进 plan 补充任务，执行，验证（1M 单线程 90s 应 pass 且多迭代）。

还有 memset_random 越界 bug 的记录——独立 framework bug（n%16≠0 时 underwrite），修复是另一个 patch（framework/random.cpp）。当前战役用例里谁传 n%16≠0？大部分测试对齐。不急于今晚修，记入待办（巡检日志+记忆），避免范围蔓延。老实说这个 bug 值得马上修——越界写是内存损坏源，恰好是 SDC 战役要抓的东西本身的"软件噪声"。但它要框架级验证（selftest 有 memset_random 的测试吗——selftest.cpp:806 用了它）。夜深了，控制范围：记入待办，明晚巡检后处理。不——CLAUDE.md 说"Self-verify before commit"，修 bug 是要完整验证周期的。今晚先记录。

执行 Task 2b：引擎 sm3sm4 data_size 固定 1M。
